name: Regular Beautification and Maintenance Commission Meeting
agenda_text:
CITY OF ARTESIA

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  BEAUTIFICATION AND MAINTENANCE COMMISSION

  LOCATION
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  (562) 865-6262

  DATE
  Thursday, January 18, 2024
  6:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING PUBLIC COMMENTS
Public comments received prior to the commencement of the meeting will be read at this
time. Any public comments that cannot be heard within the next 20 minutes will be heard
at the end of the meeting. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the Public Safety
Commission is prohibited from taking action on items that are not listed on the agenda,
but may refer the matter to staff or to a subsequent meeting.

OLD BUSINESS
  1. Adopt the Minutes from the November 29, 2023– Special Meeting

NEW BUSINESS
  2. Discussion Item- Brown Act Rules
  3. Discussion Item- Robert Rules of Order
  4. Discussion Item- Pass Out Spring Beautification Awards Nomination
  Forms

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS

  Adjournment to the next Regular Beautification and Maintenance Commission
  Meeting to be held on Thursday, April 18, 2024 at 6:00 P.M.

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please
contact City Hall at (562) 865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
